title: APPLIED MATHEMATICS FOR PHYSICAL CHEMISTRY
description: Explores mathematics concepts like functions, logarithms, calculus (multivariable), differential equations, and vector analysis, applied specifically to solve problems within the field of physical chemistry, including topics like thermodynamics, kinetics, and quantum mechanics. Serves as an optional supplementary recitation course for CH 440.
